name: Morningstar Storage
notes: Researched from the public Make a Payment, Pay as Guest and My Account log-in pages (no sign-in, no guest lookup). New payment portal: Sign in to Your Account with the same email and password as the previous portal; Create a New Account links your unit(s); Pay as Guest is a quick card payment found by location, unit number and the phone number on the contract (location is modelled through the account/unit field; exact lookup). Fee: credit card payments carry a 2% processing fee; ACH and co-branded Visa/Mastercard debit cards are free online (the fee model charges every card 2%; cross-owner request: credit-only fees). AutoPay, late fees, statements and move-out are not described publicly; the catalog note says to call 1-800-671-7552, so autopay is marked unknown with a contact note and move-out unsupported online (inferred). FAQ is only reachable through the footer and returns 404 at /faq.

guest_pay.note: Pay as Guest is a quick card payment: enter your unit number and the phone number on your contract.

registration.note: Create a New Account, then select your unit(s) to link them to your online account.

autopay.note: For automatic monthly payments, please call Morningstar Storage at 1-800-671-7552 or ask your store.

cancel_service.note: Moving out is not done online. Contact your Morningstar store or call 1-800-671-7552.

notes: Only credit cards carry the 2% fee. ACH and co-branded Visa or Mastercard debit cards are free online, and personal or cashier's checks are free in person.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Morningstar has a new payment portal. Sign in with the same email and password you used on the previous portal, create a new account and link your units, or pay as a guest.
Pay as Guest is a quick card payment: you enter your location, unit number and the phone number on your contract.
steps: Sign in, or choose Pay as Guest.
Pick your unit and the amount.
Choose ACH or a card and submit.

help.title: Processing fee
paragraphs: Credit card payments carry a 2% processing fee. Paying online by ACH or with a co-branded Visa or Mastercard debit card is free, and so is paying in person by personal or cashier's check.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: The payment pages do not describe automatic payments. Call 1-800-671-7552 or ask your store about setting up recurring payments.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: Moving out is arranged with your store rather than online. Contact your Morningstar location or call 1-800-671-7552.

extra.intent: Using Morningstar Storage's payment pages, find the processing fee on credit card payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Credit card payments have a 2% processing fee.
